request.text: At 7:00 tonight, remind me to put my passport and charger in my carry-on. Don't assume I've packed them just because the reminder time arrived.

responsibilities.outcome: At 7:00 tonight, remind the user to put their passport and charger in their carry-on without claiming that either item has been packed.

new_goals.description: Remind the user at 7:00 tonight to put their passport and charger in their carry-on.
new_goals.source_text: At 7:00 tonight, remind me to put my passport and charger in my carry-on. Don't assume I've packed them just because the reminder time arrived.
constraints: Do not infer that the passport or charger has been packed from elapsed time.
success_criteria: At the due time, the user receives the requested packing reminder.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The request establishes one timed personal-packing reminder goal.

semantic_facts: Because the authored time condition is now due, the next scoped action is to deliver the packing reminder without creating a duplicate reminder.
Elapsed time provides no Evidence that either item has been packed.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the passport or charger is already packed.
The assistant claims that the timed reminder's delivery proves the packing task is complete.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due condition is mistaken for Evidence that the user's real-world packing task is complete.
Re-entry recreates an already-authored reminder instead of performing the due communication.
